text_block_list.text: One day, while walking along the riverbank……

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch... Did I mess up the formula? No, impossible. Then it's the data...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? That ain't got nothin' to do with――

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Nah, maybe we just don't have enough data to work with.
Hey, let me hear your thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'm running a simulation based on the heart rate data right now, but I ain't getting the results I need.

Afterward, she started getting into specific formulas,
but it was way over my head...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, whatever. I'm dropping this whole approach.
Decided. Right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That was always the plan from the start.
Told ya I was droppin' 'this direction.'

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No way in hell I'm half-assing this
without proving my equation.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Obsessing over it is risky, too.
I'm confident this time, so obviously I'll rebuild it. Later.

Air Shakur immediately switched gears
and walked off with her tablet in hand.
She must be intending to sit down and grind out the answer.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You sayin' my verification is insufficient?
I've run the necessary number of trials already.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I mean, blindly chasing possibilities without any proof, shutting your brain off, and just pushing forward... it's so stupid—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Were the parameters on those trial runs too loose?
Guess I'll adjust the inputs and run it again...

Watching her closely afterward,
it seemed she got results she was satisfied with.
